models.name: Spicy Nacho
models.description:
Performance shortboard for intermediate to advanced surfers. This board works great in all conditions as it is designed for everyday waves for your local beachies and reefs. A quality all-rounder.

Outline

The nose is pushed out a little wider than the average shortboard, straight outline through the centre to maximise speed. Ive pushed out the tail width and then pulled into the swallow, this creates a nice curve in the outline and a big sweet spot when turning of your back foot. This outline compliments the bottom curve and concaves in in the back half of the board.

Rails

Medium soft rail profile. Single to deep double conaves, flat out the tail

models.name: Flying Taco
models.description:
Small wave shortboard that performs well in small average/poor conditions. This board will increase your wave count and turn average surf into a fun session! Great for turns and aerial maneuvers.

Outline

Wider outline at nose and tail to maximise volume. Slightly straight trough center to enhance speed. The tail block is a wide area round square/ diamond tail. This extra width increases surface area for flat sections while the late Vee in tail loosens up the boards maneuverability to enable turns in small tight pockets of the wave.

Rails

Low soft rail

Wave sizes
